name: Korolova
description:
'''Olga Korolova''' (born 17 March 1988), also known as '''Korolova''', is a Ukrainian DJ and music producer. She primarily produces [[melodic techno]] and [[progressive house]] music.

Korolova has played the main stage at the music festival [[Tomorrowland (festival)|Tomorrowland]], performed at [[Electric Daisy Carnival|EDC]] Las Vegas, [[Untold Festival|Untold]], NEON Countdown, So Track Boa, [[Parookaville]], and collaborated with record labels Tomorrowland Music, [[Insomniac (promoter)#Insomniac Music Group|Insomniac]], and [[Anjunabeats]].

Korolova released tracks on [[Ultra Records]], [[Armada Music|Armada]], [[AFTR:HRS]], and [[Get Physical Music]], before starting her own label, Captive Soul, in 2023.

In 2023, Korolova delivered over 100 performances across 50 countries.
